title: Break your first scene
summary: Generate three beat options and put one on the page.

steps.title: Open Write on scene 3
steps.body: You're in The Long Pour, scene 3. The script sheet is the hero; the dock on the right is where AI drafts land.

steps.title: Ask for the next beat
steps.body: Press Next Beat (or Q). Three labeled candidates stream into the dock — nothing writes until you Accept.

steps.title: Accept one card
steps.body: When Accept appears on a card, click it. The beat lands in the script and the ledger may pick up new facts.

title: Lock what you love, regenerate the rest
summary: Pin a scene so the AI cannot overwrite it, then keep editing around it.

steps.title: Open Plan mode
steps.body: Plan is the board for structure. Select a scene card to inspect it.

steps.title: Select a scene
steps.body: Click scene 3 on the board. The inspector on the right shows its plan fields.

steps.title: Flip the lock
steps.body: Use the Scene lock toggle. Locked material is sacred — generation and apply will refuse to touch it.

title: Review a change before it lands
summary: See how Change Sets preview impact before anything is written.

steps.title: Enter Review
steps.body: Review lists open Change Sets, or shows one when linked from Plan. Nothing applies until you confirm.

steps.title: Drafts or the panel
steps.body: If you have a draft Change Set, open it. Otherwise you'll see the empty state — create one from a structural Plan edit.

steps.title: Remember the rule
steps.body: Preview fills after panes; Apply is disabled until previewed. Flag only and Discard never mutate the plan.

title: Audit your story's facts
summary: Walk the continuity ledger and clear the review queue.

steps.title: Open Ledger
steps.body: Ledger tracks what's true in the story. Pending facts wear an amber count on the mode switcher.

steps.title: Filter rail
steps.body: Use the filter rail to focus status or type. Start with the review queue when it has items.

steps.title: Review a fact
steps.body: Accept, edit, or reject — each action snapshots, so Undo can reverse a mistake. Pending facts appear in the amber review queue when present.

title: Steer with a one-line instruction
summary: Use the command bar and suggestion chips without opening a chat.

steps.title: Find the command bar
steps.body: The floating pill under the script is not a chat — one instruction, then generate.

steps.title: Optional chips
steps.body: When the bar is empty and focused, muted suggestion chips may appear. Click inserts text only — never auto-generates.

steps.title: Submit to draft
steps.body: Submit the instruction to stream candidates into the dock. Accept still decides what lands.

title: Undo more than one step
summary: Use Undo and the history dropdown to restore an earlier snapshot.

steps.title: Find Undo
steps.body: Top bar Undo reverts one snapshot. The ▾ control opens ancestor history.

steps.title: Open history
steps.body: Click the history control to list recent instructions with relative times.

steps.title: Restore when needed
steps.body: Choosing an ancestor restores that snapshot and reloads. Only ancestors of the current head are allowed.
